title: Thick cylinder, axisymmetric (Lamé)
sentence: The same thick-walled cylinder as the plane-strain example, this time revolved into an axisymmetric slice instead of meshed as a flat quarter section.
theory: Lamé's solution for a cylinder of bore $a$ and outside $b$ under internal pressure $p$ is $\sigma_{rr}(r) = \dfrac{a^2 p}{b^2 - a^2}\left(1 - \dfrac{b^2}{r^2}\right)$ and $\sigma_{\theta\theta}(r) = \dfrac{a^2 p}{b^2 - a^2}\left(1 + \dfrac{b^2}{r^2}\right)$; at the bore $\sigma_{\theta\theta} = 100\,\mathrm{MPa}$ and $\sigma_{rr} = -p = -60\,\mathrm{MPa}$. `model.setIdealisation{axisymmetric}` solves one 2D slice in (r, z) and reconstructs the hoop direction from $u_r/r$ rather than meshing it, which is why this and `lame-cylinder-plane-strain` land on the same stresses from two different idealisations.
